title: Israeli Strike on North Gaza Police Station Kills 8
detail: An Israeli air strike hit a police station in the al-Faluja area of Jabalia refugee camp, northern Gaza, on July 14, 2026, killing at least 8 people, including six police officers and one civilian; Gaza's Civil Defence said the dead included a female officer. Gaza's Interior Ministry called the strike a "horrific massacre." A separate Israeli gunfire incident the same day killed a 10-year-old child in the al-Mawasi area of Khan Younis, bringing the day's Gaza-wide death toll to at least 11.
